feed.title: Interest rates
feed.summary: An interest rate is the price paid for borrowing money or earned for lending it.
feed.body: Central-bank policy rates influence financial conditions, but a policy change does not determine a particular asset’s future return. Borrower terms and risks differ.
feed.effectiveLabel: Educational definition · authored content

source.rights: Original educational content authored in this repository, not provider news. No investment advice.

feed.title: Inflation
feed.summary: Inflation is a rise in the general level of prices over time.
feed.body: An inflation rate describes price changes across a selected basket. Your own expenses can change at a different rate. Annual CPI history is not the newest monthly release.
feed.effectiveLabel: Educational definition · authored content

feed.title: GDP growth
feed.summary: GDP measures the value of goods and services produced in an economy over a period.
feed.body: Real GDP growth adjusts for price changes. It describes aggregate economic activity, not a company’s profit or the return on your investments.

event.mechanism: Supply interruption → possible fuel cost pressure → airline operating costs → exposure in an airline holding. Exposure measures capital linked to this scenario, not expected loss.
